decisions.mapping: Open-Meteo WMO codes: partly cloudy to Cloud shadows; fog to Fog; drizzle, rain, showers and thunderstorms to Rain; snow to Snow; clear, mostly clear and overcast to no effect; unknown codes fall back to Moving effect.
decisions.intensity_cap: Light, Moderate and Heavy are 40%, 70% and 100% of the person's own Density, Opacity or Coverage, rounded up. The weather never exceeds that setting.
decisions.stale_cutoff: Two Weather refresh intervals (30 min at the default 15 min), never more than 3 h. Readings more than 5 min in the future are ignored. A wake at the expiry hands control back to Moving effect.
decisions.precedence: Pauses (Reduce motion, lock, sleep, battery, unknown session, Arrange, speed 0) win; then a current weather reading; otherwise Moving effect.
decisions.override: No timed manual override in this version: the person's setting is the cap, and turning Match the weather off is the override.
decisions.transitions: 1.5 s fade out to the plain wallpaper, then 1.5 s fade in. Quiet scenes fade out before their surface is removed; pauses remove surfaces at once. The Settings preview and fixed-time captures never fade.
decisions.data: The desktop reads FB07's shared weather hub only while the Weather widget is shown; Settings reads the widget's cache file and watches it. No request is made for the effect.

tests.coverage: Every mapped code and the unknown fallback; cap and rounding; stale, missing, future and different-city readings; precedence including Moving effect None; Reduce motion, pause and speed 0; desktop fades in, between scenes and out without regenerating the effect field; frozen effects finish their fade then stop; the Weather widget hidden, a city change and reading expiry on the desktop; calm weather fading out before the surface goes; the Settings toggle by native click, Apply, state text, effect controls following the weather, a density edit that keeps Moving effect, stale text, Reduce motion label, Undo, duplicate IDs and overflow.

captures.review: Each capture reviewed: the Match the weather row and its state line fit at 820 and 1280 in light and dark, with no clipping or overlap; the snow controls follow the weather's effect; the stale state names the fallback.

environment.method: halcyon.service stopped; release build run with DESKTOP_CARDS_CONFIG and XDG_CONFIG_HOME/XDG_STATE_HOME/XDG_DATA_HOME/XDG_CACHE_HOME pointing at temporary copies; the service was started again by the same bounded command (it ended active). The user's config was never written.

desktop_run.fake_weather: A cached Weather widget reading of code 63 (moderate rain) for the temporary config's city, dated 28 min 45 s old so it went stale 75 s into the run. The app ran under unshare --map-current-user -n, a network namespace with only loopback (the live process's namespace was confirmed different from the host's), so no weather API was called; the Weather widget showed “Refresh failed”.
desktop_run.config: Weather widget shown, Moving effect Snow, Match the weather on.
sequence: Startup: rain faded in from the plain wallpaper (captures at 1 s and 2 s).
Weather rain played at the Moderate level: rain density 35, 70% of the person's 50.

At the reading's expiry the wake fired with no other event: rain faded out and Snow (Moving effect) faded in; the frame trace shows the switch about 1.5 s after the expiry; ten captures across the window.
Moving effect set to None: the snow faded out over five captures (mean difference from the clean wallpaper 150 → 136 → 122 → 105 → 94; visible flakes 427 → 59), then the surface was removed.
App log: no warnings or errors (RUST_LOG=warn).

screenshots.kept: Private scratch only; they show the owner's open windows.

gpu.source: /proc/<pid>/fdinfo drm-engine-gfx, summed over unique drm-client-id, for halcyon and cosmic-comp, over about 10.5 s per case
gpu.note: Busy time at about 29.7 fps (frame trace). The DPM clock was not recorded, so these are not directly comparable with the FB30 run. Includes all Halcyon surfaces.

cases_ms_per_second.case: Off after the fade-out and removal

gpu.fade_cost: The fade is one uniform in the existing composite pass; it adds no pass and never regenerates the effect field.

limits: One 1080p output. No multi-monitor, HiDPI, battery-powered device, energy, suspend/resume on hardware or packaged-artifact qualification. Rapid weather updates and resume are covered by deterministic tests, not on the desktop. No allow list, separate limits or timed override. Not a release.
observed_outside_scope: The installed 0.6.1 halcyon.service process used about 90% CPU before it was stopped for the run; not investigated here.
